description: In every PA-model, for every \(m\ne0\) and \(c\), there is exactly one pair \((q,r)\) with \(c=mq+r\) and \(r\lt m\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.division_model.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (m : M) (hm : m ≠ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) (c : M) :
  ∃! qr,
    c =
        Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M
          (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M m qr.1) qr.2 ∧
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
        (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M qr.2) m
